title: RBI Monetary Policy Statement 2026-27 — 3rd Bi-monthly / 62nd MPC Meeting
summary: RBI's MPC kept the repo rate unchanged at **5.25%** for the 3rd straight review, raising GDP growth forecast and cutting inflation projection.

blocks.content: RBI's MPC kept the repo rate unchanged at **5.25%** for the 3rd straight review, raising GDP growth forecast and cutting inflation projection.

items: Met 3–5 Aug 2026; Chair: Sanjay Malhotra; members: Dr. Nagesh Kumar, Saugata Bhattacharya, Prof. Ram Singh, Dr. Poonam Gupta, Indranil Bhattacharyya
Stance: Neutral | SDF: 5% | MSF & Bank Rate: 5.50%
CPI FY27: lowered to **5%** (from 5.1%); Q2 4.7%, Q3 5.9%, Q4 5.5%; June 2026 actual CPI 4.4%; Core inflation FY27: 4.3%
Gross FDI inflows Apr–Jun 2026: $30.7 bn (vs $26.7 bn YoY); forex import cover >10 months, external debt cover 90.8%
Also flagged El Niño as an inflation-growth risk via crop output

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Repo rate 5.25% (unchanged) + GDP 6.7% + CPI 5% — near-certain MCQ; this is the only MPC meeting across the fortnight.
